fields.rt-blog-html:
This article is intended for restaurant entrepreneurs (franchises, chains, independent owners, etc.) who believe that digital tools can help them better understand customer behavior, analyze sales, and develop new sales channels. If you haven’t taken the plunge yet, here are all the benefits of implementing a sales analytics tool in your restaurant—specifically an AI-native platform like Atlas, the restaurant industry’s ChatGPT developed by Innovorder.

‍

Restaurant sales analysis: what are we talking about?

Restaurant sales analysis involves a detailed examination of sales data in order to understand the restaurant's commercial performance. This analysis helps identify sales trends, strengths and weaknesses. This provides valuable information for the restaurateur, whose aim is to make informed decisions on management and sales strategy.

Today, restaurant sales analysis is no longer limited to a simple reporting tool. It is carried out through an intelligent platform like Atlas, Innovorder’s AI-native solution. Where traditional tools stop at data visualization, Atlas goes further thanks to artificial intelligence: automatic anomaly detection, identification of opportunities, and recommendations for concrete actions, ranked by expected business impact. Here are the key elements that emerge during restaurant sales analysis:

  • Overall sales: This is the total amount of sales generated over a given period. It measures the restaurant's overall performance.
  • Sales by product category: It's useful to segment sales by product category, such as appetizers, main courses, desserts, alcoholic and non-alcoholic beverages, etc. This helps you understand which products are the most popular and contribute the most to your restaurant's revenue. This allows you to understand which products are the most popular and which contribute the most to the restaurant's revenue.
  • Sales by time of day: Atlas’s hourly heat map reveals specific consumer trends for each time of day. This allows you to optimize your product offerings, staff availability, and marketing initiatives by time slot.
  • Sales by day of the week: It's often useful to compare sales on different days of the week. This can reveal seasonal variations or trends specific to certain days, enabling operations to be adjusted accordingly.
  • Sales by distribution channel: If the restaurant offers additional services such as online ordering, click-and-collect, or delivery, Atlas measures their contribution to overall revenue and identifies any potential cannibalization between channels.
  • Traffic analysis: customer flow, peak activity times, average basket size, product mix… Atlas provides a detailed understanding of business activity that goes beyond mere revenue figures.
  • Network Ranking: For multi-location retailers, Atlas provides an at-a-glance comparison of store performance (revenue, number of transactions, average basket size) to identify best practices and areas where support is needed.
  • Comparison with targets and previous periods: It's important to compare current sales with pre-established targets and performance in previous periods. This enables you to assess growth, improvement or any deviations from expectations.

It's worth noting that a restaurant's sales performance is influenced by many factors that need to be taken into account during the analysis: the restaurant's location, direct competition, new consumer trends, seasonality and so on. 

‍

The 5 benefits of a sales analysis tool

1. Understanding sales performance

A management platform like Atlas gives restaurant owners a real-time overview of their location’s performance: revenue, foot traffic, average check, top-selling items, and consumption patterns. Thanks to its ultra-responsive interface—up to 50 times faster than a traditional back-office system—analyses are completed in seconds, whether you’re managing one location or 100.

2. Informed decision-making‍

Atlas does more than just present data: its AI detects weak signals, identifies opportunities, and suggests a list of action plans prioritized by expected business impact. Restaurant owners know what to do, when to act, and why: adjust production in response to an unexpected start to the day, launch a targeted promotion during a lull, or address a performance gap on a specific channel.

3. Menu optimization

By analyzing sales data for each product, Atlas helps identify top-performing items and those that are underperforming. The platform also identifies instances of cannibalization between dine-in, click-and-collect, and delivery orders, enabling menu adjustments to maximize revenue.

4. Inventory and supply management‍

Real-time sales analysis makes it possible to anticipate demand for certain products or ingredients, better adjust production volumes, and avoid waste—a particularly critical challenge for the baking, pastry, and snack industries.

5. Fraud and error detection‍

Atlas's AI automatically identifies configuration anomalies, unusual deviations in average cart value, or performance drops during a specific time period. This proactive detection allows you to act quickly, without waiting for a deviation to turn into a loss.

‍

How can digital technology help restaurateurs better analyze sales?

Digital technology opens up a host of opportunities for the foodservice industry. Whether in the kitchen or in the dining room, technological innovations are all performance levers that canenrich and boost sales: they are precious sources of differentiation for your restaurants. And more generally, investing in digital also means enhancing thebrand image of your establishment or franchise.

Digital technology is not just for the initiated. On the contrary, it's the concern of all business leaders looking for the keys to differentiating themselves or anticipating the markets of the future. 

Sell more, sell better by publishing your menu and offers in contactless mode. Opt for online booking, an invaluable time-saver.

Better inventory management through regular tracking of foot traffic allows you to adjust kitchen production volumes, ultimately leading to greater daily efficiency. Adjusting kitchen production volumes ultimately leads to greater daily efficiency. A next-generation sales analytics platform like Atlas transforms data into immediately actionable decisions, without the need for manual processing.

👉 Read the testimonial from Thierry Veil, co-founder of Bagelstein, who turned to the Innovorder ecosystem to manage his franchise network. Though initially skeptical of ordering kiosks, he eventually decided to give them a try… and the data spoke for itself: “Who am I to deprive my franchise network of this growth?” A significant increase in average basket size and smoother traffic flow prove that detailed performance tracking allows you to challenge your assumptions and make the right decisions for your network.

‍

How can you boost your restaurant's sales with Atlas?

Atlas is the first real-time, AI-native management platform designed for restaurant professionals. Built on a cloud-native architecture and a unified semantic layer, it consolidates all network data (sales, foot traffic, products, channels, VAT, locations, etc.) to provide reliable, consistent, and actionable insights for everyone—from headquarters to the point of sale.

By investing in an AI-native platform like Atlas, you gain access to detailed data and actionable recommendations to sustainably optimize your establishment’s profitability.

1. Make better decisions, faster

View all your business data in clear, concise dashboards and identify new growth opportunities. Atlas displays sales revenue, product mix, channel breakdown, average order value, and performance by location. The built-in AI detects early warning signs and suggests actions prioritized by expected business impact: you no longer just monitor your business—you know exactly what to do and when to act.

‍

"Thanks to Innovorder, my entire business is encrypted. I constantly rely on data to make my decisions." Stéphanie Merceron, BCHEF franchisee in Cholet

‍

2. Save time tracking your business

Track your business at a glance, even from your smartphone: Atlas is fully responsive and accessible anywhere—in-store, at the office, or on the go. With performance up to 50 times faster than a traditional back-office system, you can view key metrics for your retail locations in real time, without wasting any time.

In just a few seconds, you can check the revenue for each of your locations, compare their performance, or identify which channel is driving today’s business. Atlas becomes a true daily co-pilot, consulted on an ongoing basis rather than just from time to time.

Focus on the Hourly Heat Map

"Innovorder's Heat Map helps me to manage the payroll as closely as possible to the restaurant's activity, by tracking the sales generated hour by hour." Guillaume Coiffe, Smash Smash franchisee in Bordeaux

👉 To find out more: How Smash Smash became a management ace thanks to Innovorder

3. Know your customers' habits

On which day do your customers shop the most? What are their favorite products? At what times do they visit? Atlas helps you track your foot traffic and tailor your offerings: launch special promotions during off-peak hours, optimize production during peak times, and adjust your product mix to better retain your customers.

4. A French AI solution that is secure and GDPR-compliant

Atlas is built on Mistral, France’s leading artificial intelligence platform. Its architecture enforces strict customer-level isolation (dedicated storage, indexes, and keys) with access controls, ensuring that each request remains within its own scope. End-to-end encryption of data flows also ensures that customer data is never used to train models. This is an essential guarantee for retailers who want to leverage the power of AI without compromising on security.
